'dul ba'i mdo'i rnam bshad mdo'i nyi ma'i rgyan zhes
bya ba 'di ni ¦ 'dul ba 'dzin pa stan 1 pa nam mkha' rin chen dang | lung rigs smra ba grub pa seng ge ¦ dka' bcu 'dzin pa dpal ldan seng ge ¦ 'dul ba 'dzin pa byang chub dpal la sogs pa don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams kyi bskul ba'i ngor ¦ mkhyen rabs
dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag lhar bcas 'gro ba kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu mkhan chen rin po che'i byin gyis brlabs shing 'dul ba 'buM sde'i mnga' bdag 'dul ba 'dzin pa dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen dang ¦ 'dul ba 'dzin pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sku drin la rten nasbrten nas ¦ 'dul
ba mdo rtsa ba'i tshig don la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad 'ched pa dge slong blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis ¦ dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdan sa ¦ yol rin chen gling gi gtsug lag khang du lnga brgya phrag brgyad pa'i drug bcu re 3 pa ¦ sa mo bya ¦ zhi ba'i lo This is a translation of the Sanskrit “saumya”. An epithet of the 43rd year in a rang byung cycle, the sa mo bya lo “Female Earth Bird Year”. From: mkhan rgyud rnam gsum byon tshul gyi rnam thar, f. 24a; Heimbel, “The Jo gdan tshogs sde bzhi: An Investigation into the History of the Four Monastic Communities in Śākyaśrībhadra's Vinaya Tradition” Nepalica-Tibetica: Festgabe for Christoph Cüppers.
dbyar zla ra ba'i yar ngo'i tshes 3 la zin bris su bkod pa'o || mkhan chen rin po che nas 'dis pha mas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig | yi ge pa ni shAkya'i dge slong blo gros seng ge'o || phyogs dus gnas
